# HTML entities

Escape and unescape HTML entities.

Category: Encoders · ID: `html` · Search terms: entities, escape, unescape, &amp;, xml

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui html [encode|decode] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode` | `encode` | Mode. |
| `--ascii` | on/off | `false` | Non-ASCII as &#…;. When encoding, also turn non-ASCII characters into numeric entities |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/html`), so they are what the tool prints.

### decode-mixed

Input:

```text
&lt;a href=&quot;/search?q=go&amp;lang=en&quot;&gt;Go &amp;amp; Rust&lt;/a&gt;
&copy; 2026 &mdash; caf&eacute; &#127829; &#x1F680; &unknown; &amp
```

Output:

```text
<a href="/search?q=go&lang=en">Go &amp; Rust</a>
© 2026 — café 🍕 🚀 &unknown; &
```

### encode-ascii

Input:

```text
<p class="note">Fish & chips cost <b>£5</b> — "café" isn't free.</p>
```

Output:

```text
&lt;p class=&#34;note&#34;&gt;Fish &amp; chips cost &lt;b&gt;&#163;5&lt;/b&gt; &#8212; &#34;caf&#233;&#34; isn&#39;t free.&lt;/p&gt;
```

### encode-tags

Input:

```text
<p class="note">Fish & chips cost <b>£5</b> — "café" isn't free.</p>
```

Output:

```text
&lt;p class=&#34;note&#34;&gt;Fish &amp; chips cost &lt;b&gt;£5&lt;/b&gt; — &#34;café&#34; isn&#39;t free.&lt;/p&gt;
```
